description: Baseline benchmark harness failed because importing runtime packages triggered a broken config package import path

asi.hypothesis: Benchmarking the hot path directly via Python imports would work, but runtime package __init__ side effects break import resolution
asi.rollback_reason: Harness failure only; no optimization change was tested
asi.next_action_hint: Load runtime modules directly from file paths and avoid package __init__ imports

description: Baseline benchmark for server input-to-HID hot path

asi.hypothesis: The current reducer/report-building path is the main latency surface worth optimizing first
asi.benchmark_shape: 8 devices, alternating state updates, median across 5 repeats
asi.workload_notes: Pure Python hot path benchmark without BLE hardware to isolate reducer/report costs

description: Baseline for reducer-to-publish latency on the server hot path

asi.hypothesis: Reducer work is a minority of the total; publish/write signaling is likely the main optimization target
asi.benchmark_shape: 8 devices, alternating device state changes, includes report publication and shared-memory signaling
asi.workload_notes: Pure Python benchmark avoids BLE hardware but models the server hot path more closely than reducer-only timing
